title: auth-status
description: `projects auth status --json`: where API mode points and whether this machine holds a credential for it. It reports what the machine holds, not what a token claims.

schema_version.description: The version of this document's shape. A field added keeps it, and a field reshaped or removed raises it.

logged_in.description: A token is stored for this machine's client. For a service or a handed token, a token was granted just now.

configured.description: The config file sets every value its credential type needs.

type.description: A person's device login, the client-credentials grant PROJECTS_CLIENT_SECRET selects, or a token token_command hands.

api.description: Empty where the config file sets none.

session.description: What asking the provider for a token found. Null where nothing was asked.

backend.description: Where the token is kept. Null where none is stored.

keyring_note.description: The keyring's own failure, where it is why no token was found.
